parsed.name: NI计数器输出模块
parsed.description: 这是一类美国国家仪器（NI）的数据采集计数器/定时器输出硬件，用于产生可设定延时、高电平时间、低电平时间和周期的脉冲序列，并可配置外部触发源与触发沿。它常用于实验中的时序控制、同步触发、脉冲信号产生以及与其他仪器的联动。
parsed.description_en: This is a National Instruments data acquisition counter/timer output device used to generate pulse sequences with configurable initial delay, high time, low time, and period, with support for external trigger source and trigger edge selection. It is commonly used in laboratories for timing control, synchronization, trigger generation, and coordination with other instruments.
